Based on my research, here are some great icon libraries that support React 19 and React Native:

1. **@expo/vector-icons** (Already included in your project)
- Comes with Expo by default
- Includes multiple icon sets like MaterialIcons, Ionicons, FontAwesome, etc.
- Fully compatible with React 19
- No additional setup needed since you're using Expo

2. **@react-native-vector-icons/common** (New modular approach)
- The latest version of react-native-vector-icons
- Split into individual packages for better tree-shaking
- Fully compatible with React 19
- Includes all major icon sets

3. **@nandorojo/heroicons**
- Beautiful, modern icon set from the creators of Tailwind CSS
- Tree-shakeable components
- Full TypeScript support
- Works with Expo and React 19
- Uses react-native-svg under the hood

4. **@mrkpatchaa/react-native-ionicons**
- Latest version of Ionicons (v6+)
- Compatible with React 19
- Clean, modern design
- Uses react-native-svg

I would recommend sticking with @expo/vector-icons since:
1. It's already included in your project
2. No additional setup required
3. Provides access to multiple icon sets
4. Fully compatible with React 19
5. Well maintained as part of the Expo ecosystem
